blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Former President Rodrigo Duterte’s defense counsel before the International Criminal Court (ICC) has opposed the prosecution’s request to admit as evidence the recorded testimonies of two witnesses without requiring them to testify in court. The prosecution had previously requested the court to allow the panel to make part of the case records the recorded testimonies of witnesses “P-1370,” “P-1393” and “P-1416,” even if they did not testify before the court. According to the prosecution, the testimonies of the three potential witnesses were “relevant to murders, including under count 3” allegedly committed by Philippine National Police officers in the […]...
